title: Template-derived ADR instance
context: USF needs a reviewable ADR JSON instance shape corresponding to docs/adr/template.md before numbered decision ADRs are authored.
decision: Template-derived ADR instances use the zero-padded numeric prefix plus kebab-case semantic title required by adr.schema.json and the directory naming standard.
consequences: Future ADRs can be checked against adr.schema.json before acceptance.
The Markdown template remains human-readable while JSON instances provide schema validation evidence.
invariants: ADRs remain rank-2 decision records and do not define product behaviour without semantic references.
A template-derived fixture is not itself an accepted numbered decision ADR.
permittedChanges: A future ADR registry may define the canonical home for machine-readable ADR instances.
forbiddenDrift: Do not create generic prose decisions without semantic references, invariants, forbidden drift, consequences, and AI-alignment rules.
Do not treat this template fixture as an accepted ADR.
aiAlignmentRules: Read the relevant USF semantic definitions and accepted ADRs before authoring a new ADR.
Stop if the proposed ADR would contradict the Charter or Authority Model.
rationale: The fixture proves that the template field set can be represented as an adr.schema.json instance without creating an accepted numbered decision.
description: Positive validator fixture derived from docs/adr/template.md for the ADR template and numbering convention.
aiGuidance: Use this record only as validator evidence for the template shape; it does not authorise any numbered decision.
